_note: Fake review quotes shown in idle mode, keyed by game id. All of them are made up; edit freely.

boomerang-fu.q: I was sliced in half by an avocado. With a boomerang. On the rebound. Ten out of ten.
One hit and you're sushi. Literally, I was playing the sushi.
Someone picked up the teleport power-up and I haven't trusted anyone since.

towerfall.q: Ran out of arrows, stomped on his head instead. Archery has never been this personal.
Caught an arrow mid-air with a perfectly timed dodge and the whole room stood up.
Bomb arrows from the treasure chest. That's all you need to know.

tricky-towers.q: My tower was perfect until a wizard turned my brick into a giant one. Friendships were tested.
It's falling-block puzzle stuff, but the blocks have PHYSICS. The wobble haunts my dreams.
Spent my light magic gluing the tower together like it was IKEA furniture.
tricky-towers.by: Someone who should have read the manual

cake-bash.q: I fought three other cakes to be the most delicious. I lost. I was eaten anyway.
Collect toppings, punch dessert, get chosen by the customer. Truly the circle of life.
Never seen grown adults this angry about sprinkles.

speedrunners.q: Hooked the ceiling, overtook everyone, fell off the screen. Classic me.
The screen shrinks and whoever drops off the edge is out. It's musical chairs at 200 km/h.
Dropped a crate behind me and took out two friends at once. Best moment of the year.

speedrunners-2.q: Same grappling-hook chaos, now with more ways to ruin your friends' day.
speedrunners-2.by: Grapple Gary, older and no wiser

speedrunners-2.q: It's a demo and we still argued about it for an hour.
I came for the speed. I stayed for the betrayal.

uch.q: I placed a crossbow to stop you and it shot ME. That's the game. That's the whole review.
First everyone builds the level, then everyone races it. Nobody builds a fair level. Ever.
If everyone finishes, nobody scores. So we put a black hole next to the flag.

ultimate-sheep.q: Sheep. Raccoons. Absolute nonsense. I can't stop laughing.
From the people who taught us to hate our friends in Ultimate Chicken Horse.
I don't fully understand what happened but the raccoon won and I respect it.

nplusplus.q: Grab gold for more time, hit the switch, reach the door, die to a homing rocket. Repeat 400 times.
Co-op levels where one ninja is a stepping stone for the other. Trust exercises with mines.
The physics are so clean it feels like flying. Right up until the drone gets you.

super-meat-boy.q: At the end of the level it replays ALL your deaths at once. Forty meat boys hitting one saw blade.
Pass the pad. Die. Pass the pad. Somebody gets it on try 73 and is a hero for the rest of the night.
I wall-jumped through a saw blade corridor to save Bandage Girl and I'd do it again.

super-hexagon.q: Rotate a tiny triangle, dodge walls, survive sixty seconds. I lasted four.
The announcer said 'Begin!' and then said 'Game over' about two seconds later.
The best game for passing the controller. Nobody holds it for long.

overcooked-2.q: Now you can THROW the onions. Our kitchen became a war zone.
The kitchen split in half on a moving platform while the stove was on fire. Three stars.
We have stopped speaking to each other. The soup was perfect.

moving-out.q: Why carry the couch through the door when you can throw it through the window?
moving-out.by: Smooth Moves Employee of the Month

moving-out.q: Two people on the fridge, one on the TV, everyone screaming 'PIVOT'.
Packed the whole house in under three minutes. The house did not survive.

lovers.q: One on the turrets, one on the shield, one on the engine and NOBODY on the laser. Space is hard.
Running around a neon pink spaceship rescuing space bunnies is my love language.
I yelled 'SHIELD LEFT!' so loudly the neighbours called.

ship-of-fools.q: Reload the cannon, patch the hole in the hull, fire at the sea monster. Simultaneously. Badly.
Two fools, one boat, a whole ocean of tentacles. Perfect co-op.
I fished during the calm part and then forgot to load the cannons. We sank.

heave-ho.q: Each trigger is one hand. Hold your friend's hand, swing, let go at the wrong time. Pure friendship.
We made a human chain across a pit and then someone sneezed.
Four dangling little guys, one goal, zero coordination. Best party game ever.

mount-your-friends.q: Each limb has its own button. You climb on top of your friends. That's it. Nobody can breathe from laughing.
I grabbed his knee, then his face, then the summit. Nobody will ever look at me the same way.
Tallest pile of muscular men wins. Do not explain this game to your parents.

myf-3d.q: Mount Your Friends but now it's 3D, so you can fall off in a whole new dimension.
Climbing a tower of friends in full 3D. Your neck will hurt from laughing.
Limbs everywhere. I won by grabbing what I think was an ear.

phogs.q: Two players, one stretchy dog with a head at each end. Who's walking who?
Stretch across a gap, bite the ledge, pull the other head over. Teamwork, but doggy.
Wholesome game. We still fought over which end goes first.

bread-and-fred.q: Two penguins tied together climbing a mountain. If one falls, you both fall. Trust issues: unlocked.
One anchors, one swings. We swapped roles a lot. Mostly while falling.
We lost twenty minutes of progress in four seconds and laughed about it. Eventually.

pico-park.q: Eight cats, one key, one door. Seven people solved it. One person jumped on the key and fell into the void.
You need everyone to push the block. Everyone. Including Dave, who went the wrong way.
Stacking cats on each other's heads to reach the exit. Diplomacy at its finest.

pico-park-2.q: More levels, more cats, more ways for one person to ruin everything.
Eight players on one screen and every single one has a different plan.
The minute everyone finally cooperates, it feels like winning the World Cup.

escape-academy.q: Escape rooms with a timer and one partner yelling numbers at you. Surprisingly perfect.
We solved the puzzle with three seconds left by guessing. Academic excellence.
Split screen means you can't see what your partner sees. So you shout. A lot.

split-fiction.q: Every chapter is a different game. Sci-fi chase one minute, riding a dragon the next.
Two writers stuck in their own stories, so you swap between laser bikes and magic every level.
We put down our drinks for this one. That's the highest praise LANIT gives.

circuit-superstars.q: Top-down racing, but with pit stops and tyre wear. I pitted for fresh tyres and still came last.
Overtook on the last corner and my friend said things I can't repeat.
Easy to pick up, and the drifting feels great even when you're on drink four.

make-way.q: Everyone places track pieces before the race. Someone always puts a loop right after a jump.
I built the shortcut. I died on the shortcut. Poetry.
Little cars, giant loops, pure sabotage. Mario Kart wishes.

fling.q: You're tied to your teammate with a giant elastic band. Slingshot them across the finish line!
Two teams of two, each pair on a rope, everyone flinging everyone into the void.
Perfect fling, perfect landing, perfect high five. Then we fell off the map.

tmnt.q: Threw a Foot Soldier straight at the screen just like in the arcade. I cried a little.
Four turtles, April, Splinter and pizza boxes healing you. Cowabunga, honestly.
Pixel art so good it hurts, and a beat 'em up anyone can play drunk.

shootas.q: Orks, big guns, more dakka. You collect teef as money. Teef!
Run, shoot, explode, find a fancier hat. Excellent Ork life choices.
Co-op run and gun where friendly yelling is part of the strategy.

gungeon.q: A bullet hell where you dodge roll through bullets with tiny legs. Also there's a gun that shoots bees.
Player two is the Cultist, which means player two is always the one who dies first.
I've put 545 hours into this and I still panic at the first boss.
gungeon.by: The guy who set up this kiosk

necrodancer.q: Every move has to land on the beat. The skeletons dance too. The shopkeeper sings along.
It's a dungeon crawler but you have to bop your head to survive. Banger soundtrack.
Drunk rhythm games: nobody is on beat, everyone is having fun.

blobby-knockout.q: Everyone shares two blobs. Touch the ball, it crosses the net, you're out and the next person takes over. Genius.
Our friends' FACES are on the blobs. I spiked myself in the face. Twice.
Drunk mode runs the whole game at 60% speed. Made by LANIT, for LANIT.
